text: Hello and welcome to the live coverage of this Premier League game between Luton Town and Bournemouth!
Rob Edwards’ team talk might be pretty easy, just remind them of the game they played at the Vitality Stadium.
They were 3-0 up and coasting at half-time but a spectacular Bournemouth arrived after the break and scored four goals to win the game.
They have a perfect opportunity to get revenge here and make sure that Bournemouth don’t do the double over them for the first time since 2007/08.
That was when they were both in League One, but Bournemouth did win 4-3 at home against them that season as well, so has much really changed?
Bournemouth have turned a corner.
It looked a bit doom and gloom at the start of 2024 after they had struggled to win and got knocked out of the FA Cup by Championship side Leicester City.
That has completely changed and since their cup exit they haven’t lost, and that included an incredible 4-3 comeback against today’s opponents Luton.
The Cherries have loved playing away and they have only lost two of their last nine on the road, so it could be a cracker here at Kenilworth Road.
Luton are in their toughest spell since coming up to the Premier League, they haven’t won in their last ten games but that hasn’t stopped Edwards from being consistent with his line-up.
He has made two changes from their 2-0 defeat to Arsenal midweek.
Burke and Chong come in while Onyedinma and Mpanzu drop to the bench.
Luton sit three points behind Nottingham Forest who are 17th, and this is the team that Edwards’ trust to close the gap.
With a tight game on Tuesday against Crystal Palace, Andoni Iraola has made a few changes.
He has rewarded Kluivert with a start after he scored the winner against Palace, and Kerkez and Semenyo also come into the starting line-up.
Senesi makes his return to the bench after injuring himself against Burnley a month ago, and with the team in such fine form, Indoni has opted for as little change as possible.
Bournemouth's last visit to Bedfordshire was two years ago, and that was when the two teams were in the Championship.
The two sides have been great stories as they have risen through the leagues and kick-off in their Premier League game is only moments away.
Andy Madley has blown the whistle and we are underway at Kenilworth Road.
Neither team has managed to keep possession well in the early stages.
Barkley gives the ball away and Luton get it straight back.
Barkley has the first effort of the game, and hopefully, the quality gets a bit better.
He collects the ball on the edge of the D and lofts his shot over the goal.
Chong tries to catch Bournemouth out with a quick throw-in to Doughty, but Smith gets back and blocks the cross and it goes out for a corner.
Luton have the ball in Bournemouth's box but as Doughty takes the ball down he is deemed to have used his hand, and Bournemouth hold on.
It was a tight call but the Cherries get away with it.
OFF THE BAR! What an effort from Tavernier! He takes a stuttered run-up on his free-kick and cannons his effort off the part of the woodwork where the post and crossbar meet.
Kaminski was scrambling, it's difficult to say if he would have saved it.
It was a great shot.
Bournemouth are slightly cranking up the pressure, and Solanke pressures Doughty into giving away a throw-in.
Tavernier is looking lively.
Solanke lays the ball off to him, and the young winger continues to move inwards until he hits a bending effort that flashes past the post.

source.label: assist
source.text: Solanke lays the ball off to him

text: OFF THE POST AGAIN! LUTON ARE LIVING DANGEROUSLY! This time it's Kluivert who fancies his luck.
He picks up the ball and moves it to his right foot and aims for the far corner, it looks goal-bound but it clips the post.
Edwards waves his hands in the air, his team are seriously under pressure.
Kluivert again! This front four of Semenyo, Tavernier, Solanke and the Dutchman are causing all sorts of chaos.
Semenyo leads the counter-attack and plays through Kluivert who looks to bend his shot into the top corner but it nestles on top of the goal.

events.action: bend his shot into the top corner

text: CHONG FIRES OVER! It is all action here! Chong picks up the ball with his back to goal and he manages to swivel and shoot but it goes over.
It is a promising sign here for Luton.
Luton's medical team are on the pitch checking up on Mengi.
He sat down off the ball, and they are stretching his right leg out.
We are back underway he and Clark has to flick Tavernier's cross out for a corner.

WHAT A SAVE! Kaminski somehow kept Bournemouth out! Solanke is waiting at the back post and he looks surprised that Semenyo didn't get a touch on the corner and instinctively hits the ball towards Kaminski, who slaps the shot away.
Luton are winless in their last four home games and conceded first on all four occasions.
They have come close to going behind multiple times so far but they remain level for now.
Bournemouth find themselves in a good position and Christie sprays one out wide but it hits Kerkez's hand and Madley blows for a free-kick in Luton's favour.
They were in a good position but wasted the opportunity.
Doughty delivers a poor corner but it goes out and he has a second chance to redeem himself, the wind is causing some issues for him to be fair and his second effort isn't much better.
Some brave defending from Luton to deny Bournemouth there.
Kabore puts his head in a dangerous area and scoops it clear to Chong, who adds extra distance to the clearance.
Mengi is down again after a clash of knees.
He is screaming in pain and the medics are on the pitch.
He has been in the wars in the first half.
Mengi has returned and we get back to the action with Bournemouth just passing the ball among each other.
Chong and Morris look like they were stuck in a corner but they manage to win a corner.
The wind is still causing problems for Doughty and his cross is cleared to Chong who blasts over.
Barkley opts to have another shot from the edge of the area.
This one was far better than his early chance, it was on target but got blocked on the way through.
There are only three minutes added on in this half.
HALF-TIME: LUTON TOWN 0-0 BOURNEMOUTH
Bournemouth had their chances to take a first-half lead, but they found Kaminski and the woodwork a familiar foe.
Tavernier struck the post with a venomous free-kick, and then Kluivert clipped the same post as he tried to find the far corner.
Kaminski then reacted well to deny Solanke.
The travelling side have shown why they are unbeaten in five games but they slowed down towards the end of the half.
Luton have struggled to forge chances, with Barkley's long-range efforts the most noteworthy.
The Cherries started to slow down towards the break, but when they quickened the play Indoni's side looked too much to handle for Luton.
Luton defended their box well with most of Bournemouth's chance coming from distance, but they have struggled to find themselves in a positive position in Bournemouth's half.
Edwards would like to see his side have a couple more shots and test Neto, who hasn't had a save to make.
FULL-TIME: LUTON 2-1 BOURNEMOUTH
We are back underway here, which team will be the first to score here?
Neto is called into action for the first time today.
Morris does well to fire across goal and Neto reacts quickly to parry it away.
It is difficult to see if it was on target or not, but the Brazilian wasn't taking any chances.
Barkley's shots are getting closer and closer.
The first went sky-high, the second was defended well and this one went through to Neto who got down low to stop the Englishman.
NETO SAVES AGAIN! He has been among it in the opening six minutes.
Morris tries to flick the ball to a teammate but it comes back to him and he drills it towards goal but Neto gets a strong hand to it.
WHAT A STRIKE! BOURNEMOUTH LEAD 1-0! Tavernier called for it and it fell perfectly in his path to drill his effort into the bottom corner.

events.action: drill his effort into the bottom corner

text: It might be a bit harsh on Luton after such a strong start after the break, but he was given space and punished.
Kluivert played a simple pass, but it was weighted well and allowed Tavernier to run onto it and strike it first time.
A goal and an assist in his last two games now for the Dutchman.
Barkley shrugs off Semenyo and runs into space, he tries to poke it into the corner but doesn't hit the ball right and it bobbles wide of Neto's goal.
Tavernier is down injured and he looks gutted.
He scored a great goal and has been a menace to Luton's backline throughout.
The medic is on and is stretching the goalscorer's leg.
Tavernier cannot carry on and he walks straight down the tunnel and is replaced by Ouattara.
Ouattara is right into the action and is taken out as he tries to race away.
Madley has an easy decision to give a free-kick, but Kluivert puts way too much power on it and Kaminski collects the ball for a goal kick.
Hashioka has had some moments on the right-hand side but his game has been run and Berry comes on.
Townsend also comes off for Onyedinma who slots into where the Englishman was playing.
Luton fans aren't too happy with Smith as he takes his time with a throw-in and then moves a couple of yards from where he should have.
NETO SAVE AGAIN! It is fair to say Luton have had fair better chances in the second period but they have been matched by Neto.
Chong and Berry move the ball along to Doughty who tries to find the bottom corner but cannot beat Neto.
Bournemouth's goalscorer makes way for Billing with just over 20 minutes to go.
Semenyo has been the quietest out of the three behind Solanke, but he has had a good game.
Unal comes on and will play up top with Solanke and he will look to add to his sole goal in the Premier League so far.
The game has become a bit scrappy with Luton more direct in their play.
It hasn't made it the greatest affair in the past five minutes, but Bournemouth are struggling to deal with it.
GOAAAAAL! LUTON LEVEL IT! It has been coming and in the second half, it is difficult to say they don't deserve it.
Clark started the move with a surging run and carried on forward where he found himself in the box and found the bottom corner.
It is 1-1 and can Luton get a vital winner with 17 minutes to play?
It was a rather fortunate assist and it won't make Berry's showreel but he battled hard and the ball popped through to Clark who was lethal with his finish.
Bournemouth's bench aren't too happy now and Madley brandished a yellow card to one of Indoni's assistance.
Kenilworth Road has just cranked up a level as well, it is going to be a difficult final 10 minutes for Bournemouth.
Unal tries to get on the end of Solanke's through ball, but Doughty comes across and guides the ball back to his keeper.
Chong has been bright but struggled with the final ball and he makes way for Woodrow.
KAHORE AND KAMINSKI DENY SOLANKE! It was a great joint effort to stop Solanke who ran through and was met by a fierce challenge from the defender and a block from Kaminski.
Great defending.
Senesi makes his return to the Bournemouth side as he replaces Kerkez.
Scott also makes an appearance coming on for Cook, who was quiet throughout.
Bournemouth continue to not let Luton have anything once they reach their half and have defended the wide areas very well.
If not for an unfortunate deflection, they may not have found themselves pegged back.
THEY HAVE DONE IT! LUTON HAVE WON IT! Morris gets in the box and wrestles past his defender to tuck the ball into the bottom corner.

events.action: tuck the ball into the bottom corner

text: How important will that goal be for their Premier League survival? It has been coming and Morris shows great strength to get to the ball and score to make it 2-1.
Woodrow has come on and got the winning assist, what a cross!
Six minutes added on here.
Scott tries to find the far corner but is met but it goes just wide and no one can get a touch on it.
That should be it.
FULL-TIME: LUTON TOWN 2-1 BOURNEMOUTH
Morris left it late but they have won it! They are level on points with Nottingham Forest albeit having played a game extra.
It was a deserved victory with the xG 1.42 to 0.33.
Tavernier opened the scoring seven minutes after the break when he hit a driven shot past Kaminski.
It was their first flurry forward in the second half, and Neto was forced to deny Morris and Barkley on a few occasions and in the 73rd minute Clark netted the equaliser with a clinical finish.
They pushed for a winner but were met by a resilient Bournemouth, who were unbeaten in five until Morris popped up with a crucial winner.
Luton have six games to hunt Nottingham Forest down, the next challenge... Manchester City away! Thanks for joining us and goodbye!
